text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in opening paragraph","quality":"clear position","description":"It states a definite argument for developing driverless cars right away and returns to that claim throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"separate paragraphs on energy, safety, convenience, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"It groups ideas into distinct sections that make the line of argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"“first caveman produced fire” to “driverless cars”","quality":"rhetorical framing","description":"It uses a broad historical frame to make the argument feel larger and more persuasive."},{"evidence":"explanation of CO2, pollution, sea levels, and ecosystems","quality":"elaboration","description":"It expands source evidence into fuller reasoning rather than just mentioning facts."},{"evidence":"“There are simply too many advantages to be ignored” and closing call to “move from fire to electricity”","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends with a decisive summary and memorable final appeal that reinforces the stance."}]}
